author: Nerdstalgic
description:
From writing iconic sketches on Saturday Night Live to creating cult classics like Mr. Show with Bob and David…to becoming one of the most unforgettable characters in TV history as Saul Goodman in Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul.  Bob Odenkirk has reinvented himself more times than we can count.  

His collective body of work already made no sense, but his turn as "A Suburban Dad Turned John Wick" cemented yet another era in an already illustrious acting career. 

But how exactly does a sketch comedy legend/criminal lawyer become an action star…decades into their career?  And how has Bob Odenkirk done this with such perfection?

#breakingbad #bettercallsaul #bobodenkirk #nerdstalgic
title: When A Comedy Star Decides To Be An Action Star
